title: CoSER: A Comprehensive Literary Dataset and Framework for Training and Evaluating LLM Role-Playing and Persona Simulation

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the correlation between the number of simulation rounds (length) and penalty-based scores assigned by LLM judges using linear regression, and implementing a length-correction formula to compensate for points deducted solely due to increased output length.

Comparing human evaluation preferences with the scores and win rates assigned by various LLM judges (e.g., GPT-4o, DeepSeek-R1) to identify if the judges disproportionately favor text generated by models from their own family.
